purpose: Application service that assembles category configuration rows into the public category family contract.
businessRules: Only active category families are returned by the public read API.
Category product types, attributes, filters, taxes, and styling are grouped under the owning family.
Controllers depend on this service instead of reading repositories directly.
Public category reads are KV-first when every dependent category table has KV enabled.
Category mutations refresh the active category-family aggregate through this service after database writes.
